narratives.body: Reports confirm a French-born forward eligible for the Super Falcons has joined Chelsea on a professional deal (report_1). Additionally, Chelsea is planning a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine (report_2). The club beat Manchester United to secure a signing, while Liverpool's latest transfer news was also covered (report_4). A player with 23 minutes of playing time this season has been urged to leave the club (report_21).
narratives.headline: Chelsea signs French forward, plans move for Strasbourg winger; player urged to leave

narratives.body: Chelsea Football Club official sources state that Danny Welbeck is focused on leadership, family, and honouring communities (report_3). Rachael Adedini's profile was published by the club (report_6). George Weah recalled his historic debut derby winner against Tottenham (report_20). A Chelsea wonderkid sent an 'awesome' message to Xabi Alonso (report_24).
narratives.headline: Chelsea players Welbeck, Adedini, Weah and a wonderkid featured in club updates

narratives.body: Football London reported that Chelsea was labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City despite an 114-charge guilty verdict, with Simon Jordan making the claim (report_13, report_19).
narratives.headline: Chelsea labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City despite guilty verdict
